review_candidates.description: Technical Specialist – Risk and Safety Systems Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Japan’s (APJ) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company? AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow. Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APJ region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning… Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground. A Snapshot The Technical Specialist – Risk and Safety Systems is responsible for the day-to-day support, administration, optimisation and adoption of technology platforms supporting the Risk and Safety functions. Reporting to the Service Owner, this role provides Level 2 and Level 3 support, manages secure system access, delivers minor enhancements and supports the transition of new capabilities into business-as-usual operation. Working closely with business and technology stakeholders, the role identifies improvement opportunities, assesses product releases, and contributes insight to roadmaps and backlogs. Your Day to Day Platform Support & Administration Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for incidents and service requests, coordinating vendor or specialist escalation where required. Work with the Service Desk to manage approved access requests for secure platforms, applying least-privilege and access-control requirements. Proactively engage users to diagnose and resolve issues, using real-time channels such as Microsoft Teams. Configure and maintain platform settings, workflows, templates and permissions in line with change, security, privacy and governance requirements. Monitor service health, usage and data quality, and address recurring issues through root cause analysis and preventative improvement. Optimisation, Roadmap & Adoption Use Risk and Safety process knowledge, service trends, user feedback and platform analytics to identify opportunities for simplification, automation and improved user experience. Review vendor roadmaps and release notes, assess business value and impact, and provide structured recommendations to inform the Service Owner's roadmap and backlog. Deliver minor enhancements through requirements clarification, configuration, testing, user acceptance, communication, demonstrations and adoption support. Support the Service Owner, Business Analysts and delivery teams on major changes, with a focus on operational readiness and controlled transition into business-as-usual support. Documentation & Collaboration Maintain clear configuration, access, change and support documentation, together with user guides and knowledge articles. Build trusted relationships with business stakeholders through clear, professional and responsive communication, translating effectively between business users, technical teams and vendors. Collaborate with the Service Owner, Service Desk, Business Analysts, delivery teams and technology partners to achieve effective outcomes. Requirements Essential: o 3-5 years' experience in Risk and Safety technologies. o Practical understanding of risk and safety processes within large construction, development, or infrastructure organisations. o Experience providing Level 2 or Level 3 application support, including secure access administration, platform configuration, troubleshooting and testing. o Experience supporting system changes and translating user needs, service trends and product capabilities into practical improvement recommendations. o Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proactive approach to engaging users directly and resolving issues collaboratively. o Strong analytical, documentation and prioritisation skills, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams in varied delivery environments. Desirable o Hands-on experience configuring and administering the Protecht GRC system. o Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, including configuring and supporting custom modules. o Hands-on experience with designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards and reports by analysing, manipulating and integrating data across multiple sources to deliver accurate and meaningful insights. o Familiarity with ITIL practices or experience in a fast-paced, scaling or transformation environment. review_candidates.description: Job description: About the company: At Almosafer Travel & Tourism Co. We’re not just part of the travel industry, we’re helping shape its future. As Saudi Arabia’s leading travel company, we serve millions across every segment of the travel and tourism ecosystem. Rooted in our name “Almosafer,” meaning the traveler, we strive to make every journey seamless, personal, and purposeful. Our diverse platforms and services are built to deliver enriching experiences that reflect the spirit of Saudi Arabia and the wider region. We’re united by a bold vision: To be the undisputed leader in travel services, fostering lasting connections and setting new benchmarks for excellence in the Kingdom and beyond. Our team across Saudi Arabia and the wider region blends deep cultural understanding with forward-thinking innovation, shaping a new standard for travel in the region. About the Role: We are looking for a curious, analytical, and highly motivated Associate Product Manager (APM) to join our Platform Product team. You will help build products that power supplier connectivity, hotel availability, booking reliability, room mapping, supplier quality, and supply intelligence across the Almosafer ecosystem. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Supplier Management, Operations, Finance, Customer Experience, and Data teams to identify opportunities, launch new capabilities, improve platform performance, and solve complex operational challenges. This is a high-impact platform role where small improvements can influence millions of hotel searches and thousands of daily bookings. The ideal candidate enjoys solving ambiguous platform problems, loves working with APIs and data, and wants to build systems that operate at scale. You will report to the Senior Product Manager – Hotel Supply Platform. Responsibilities: Supplier Connectivity Support onboarding of new hotel suppliers by collaborating with engineering and supplier teams. Understand supplier APIs, booking flows, pricing models, and inventory structures. Help improve supplier onboarding efficiency and reduce integration effort. Platform Improvements Analyze booking failures, supplier issues, API errors, availability gaps, and operational escalations to identify root causes. Drive product improvements that improve booking success rate, supplier quality, and platform reliability. Product Delivery Write Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, and release documentation. Work closely with Engineering throughout discovery, development, testing, rollout, and post-launch analysis. Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and prioritization. Analytics & Insights Build dashboards and analyze supplier performance using SQL, Excel, Tableau, or similar analytical tools. Monitor KPIs and identify trends across supplier availability, booking failures, pricing competitiveness, and operational performance. Validate hypotheses using data and communicate insights clearly. AI & Automation Leverage AI tools and LLM-based assistants to improve product discovery, automate repetitive workflows, analyze supplier documentation, and accelerate product execution. Continuously identify opportunities where AI can improve platform efficiency. Cross-functional Collaboration Partner with Supplier Management, Commercial, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Customer Support, and Data teams to solve cross-functional problems. Coordinate multiple initiatives while proactively identifying risks and dependencies. Profile Requirements: Must Have 3–7 years of experience in Product Management, Business Analysis, Platform Products, Data Analytics, or Software Engineering. Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills Comfortable working with APIs, backend systems, and technical products. Experience working with SQL and Excel for data analysis. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and fast-changing environments. Good To Have Experience in TravelTech, Hospitality, OTA, SaaS, Marketplace, or Platform products. Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and system integrations. Experience with Tableau, Mixpanel, Kibana, Looker, or similar BI tools. Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar productivity tools. Exposure to hotel distribution, supplier connectivity, booking systems, or pricing platforms. Being you @ Almosafer: At Almosafer, our teams work with purpose, clarity, and a shared commitment to doing things the right way. Whether you're building platforms, supporting travelers, or shaping strategy, your work connects to something bigger. Across functions and locations, we value accountability, trust, and collaboration - and we create the structure and space for you to contribute meaningfully from day one. Here, you will find: A purpose-led workplace where your ideas can create real impact Ongoing learning and development to help you grow with intention Recognition that celebrates your wins, both big and small A community built on trust, curiosity, and shared momentum No matter where your journey started, at Almosafer, you will find space to grow, connect, and contribute meaningfully.

review_candidates.description: Overview Support the planning and delivery of Herbalife's regional and multi-market events across Asia Pacific, including distributor training, incentive retreats, leadership summits, product launches, recognition events and large-scale conferences. Partner with country Sales and Marketing teams, venues, agencies and vendors to deliver events on brief, on budget and in line with company requirements. This is a hands-on regional role requiring strong event operations, commercial judgment, contract discipline and independent management of assigned workstreams. Qualifications Plan and deliver large-scale, turnkey in-person, hybrid and virtual events from concept and site selection through contracting, onsite execution and post-event review. Review and process high-value event, hotel and venue contracts. Assess room blocks, minimum commitments, attrition, cancellation, deposits, payment terms, taxes, insurance and other commercial exposures; escalate complex legal, tax, compliance or insurance matters to the appropriate specialists. Source, evaluate, brief and manage hotels, venues, production agencies, technology suppliers, transportation, logistics, creative, staffing and other partners. Evaluate competitive proposals and prepare clear commercial recommendations based on cost, capability, risk and contractual terms. Manage event budgets, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, invoices, committed versus actual spend and post-event reconciliation; report material variances promptly. Develop event timelines, run-of-show documents, checklists, staffing plans, registration, rooming requirements, VIP and speaker logistics, transportation, hospitality, attendee communications and contingency plans. Read and assess complex AutoCAD drawings, scaled venue plans, seating layouts and production plots for capacity, attendee flow, production footprint and operational practicality, working with qualified technical and safety specialists where required. Coordinate technical delivery including power, internet, interpretation, streaming and event technology. Partner with regional leadership, country teams and functions including Finance, Procurement, Legal, Tax, IT, Security and Compliance. Translate requirements into clear decisions, responsibilities and actions. Manage onsite teams and vendors, maintain stakeholder alignment and resolve operational issues decisively during live events. Ensure event content, claims, branding, materials and delivery follow company, regulatory, health and safety, risk and data privacy requirements, including market-specific requirements. Prepare concise, executive-ready PowerPoint presentations and recommendations covering venues, budgets, commercial comparisons, layouts, risks and event status. Complete post-event reviews covering attendance, feedback, financial reconciliation, vendor performance and lessons learned; contribute to the APAC events calendar and continuous improvement. QUALIFICATIONS FOR SUCCESS: Education Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in Events, Hospitality, Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field. Essential 7 to 10 years of progressive events experience, including hands-on responsibility for complex regional or multi-country events. Demonstrated experience delivering large-scale events of 1,000+ to 20,000+ attendees, in a turnkey environment involving multiple vendors, venues and operational workstreams. Strong experience reviewing and processing high-value event and hotel contracts, with practical knowledge of room-block commitments, attrition, cancellation and commercial exposure. Strong project management, budgeting, vendor management and live-event operational skills, including overseas event delivery and site inspections. Ability to read and interpret complex AutoCAD drawings and scaled event layouts. AutoCAD editing capability is advantageous but not required. Strong PowerPoint skills and the ability to turn complex operational and commercial information into clear, decision-oriented presentations. Experience with hybrid and virtual events, event technology and technical rehearsals. Effectively bilingual in English and Mandarin, with the ability to conduct business discussions, vendor negotiations and onsite operations confidently in both languages. Comfortable working across cultures, markets and time zones, with regular APAC travel and flexibility around live-event schedules. Preferred Bahasa Malaysia and/or Cantonese is an advantage. Experience in direct selling, consumer health and wellness, FMCG or another regulated or claims-sensitive environment. Relevant professional certification or equivalent event or project management training. Core competencies Strategic and critical thinker who connects operational detail to business, financial and contractual impact. Commercially astute, budget-conscious and confident challenging assumptions and recommending practical alternatives. Highly organised and detail-oriented, with strong ownership and follow-through. Calm and solutions-focused under pressure, with sound onsite decision-making skills. Clear communicator and effective stakeholder manager across senior leaders, country teams and external partners. Culturally agile, adaptable and effective in large, diverse APAC teams. Working conditions Regular regional and international travel, including site inspections and event deployments. Flexibility to work outside standard office hours during peak planning periods, rehearsals and live events. Terms of Use Privacy Policy

review_candidates.description: Ben jij een servicegericht IT-talent dat energie krijgt van het oplossen van vraagstukken en van klanten écht verder helpen? Ben jij een ambitieuze young professional of iemand met al iets meer jaren ervaring, maar zich ook wil ontwikkelen en doorgroeien binnen een innovatieve SaaS-organisatie? Dan maken wij graag kennis met je! Jouw rol Als Service Engineer ga je na een uitgebreid intern opleidingstraject aan de slag als dé schakel tussen onze klanten en onze technologie. Je zorgt dat functionele en technische issues snel en effectief worden opgelost, en denkt proactief mee over verbeteringen. Je werkt met onze low-code oplossingen, documentherkenning, selfbilling en koppelingen met financiële software. Je leert onze klanten én producten door en door kennen. Over Whitevision Whitevision is een toonaangevende SaaS-speler in Intelligent Document Processing & Management. Wij ontwikkelen slimme, schaalbare en betrouwbare tools voor factuurverwerking, procurement, spend en document management, die naadloos integreren met een breed scala aan ERP-systemen. Vandaag de dag vertrouwen meer dan 2300 organisaties op die oplossingen. Vanuit kantoren in Breda, Rotterdam, Zoetermeer, De Goorn, Milton Keynes en Southampton werken ruim 140 medewerkers aan de doorontwikkeling en toepassing ervan, in een cultuur gebouwd op de kernwaarden betrokken, ambitieus, respectvol en daadkrachtig. En waar kom jij terecht? Je wordt onderdeel van een betrokken en informeel team van service engineers, consultants en developers: nieuwsgierig, oplossingsgericht en mét humor. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat onze klanten het maximale uit onze software halen en we vieren onze successen. We zijn continue in ontwikkeling en in jouw rol is er dan ook volop ruimte voor eigen inbreng en groei. Heb je een goed idee? Mooi, daar zijn we super geïnteresseerd in! Wat je gaat doen: Je lost functionele en technische klantvragen over onze software op. Je analyseert complexe issues en vertaalt deze naar praktische oplossingen. Je onderzoekt problemen in de koppelingen tussen onze software en backoffice systemen zoals AFAS en Exact. Je test en documenteert oplossingen en verbeteringen. Je werkt samen met development en consultancy om klantvragen structureel op te lossen. Je zet je kennis van IT en AI in om de interne processen van de afdeling slimmer te maken. +Je werkt vanuit ons leuke kantoor in Zoetermeer (in de Innovation Factory!) en deels vanuit huis. Vereisten Wat breng je mee? Een afgeronde HBO-opleiding in ICT of een vergelijkbare richting — en/of aantoonbare affiniteit met techniek. Analytisch vermogen: je doorgrondt snel waar het probleem zit en schakelt tussen techniek en klantbehoefte. Affiniteit met IT en AI, en de drive om die kennis in te zetten voor verbetering. Samenwerkingsgerichtheid: je zoekt actief de verbinding met collega’s en klanten. Stressbestendigheid, een gezonde dosis humor en relativeringsvermogen. Enthousiasme en de wil om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien. Klanten helpen, techniek doorgronden en jezelf ontwikkelen: hier komt alles bij elkaar. Jij start als Service Engineer en bouwt aan je toekomst, wij bouwen aan Whitevision in Europa. Samen maken we organisaties slimmer. Wat bieden wij? Naast het werken binnen een gezellig en gemotiveerd team bieden wij jou: Een salaris tussen €2.800 – €4.250 (o.b.v. 40 uur), 8% vakantiegeld, en 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen te kopen (o.b.v. 40 uur). Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een laptop en een mooie pensioenregeling, plus flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om thuis te werken. Een inspirerende werkomgeving met flexibiliteit in werkplek (hybride) en werktijden. Trainingen en opleidingen én volop ruimte voor eigen inbreng om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien. Een team waarin hard gewerkt wordt, én waar ruimte is voor plezier inclusief borrels en events, waar nog lang over nagepraat wordt! Interesse? Solliciteer hier ! Doorgroeimogelijkheden Deze rol is een ideaal startpunt binnen Whitevision. Je leert eerst onze klanten en producten kennen en kunt vanuit daar, afhankelijk van jouw ambities, doorgroeien naar Implementatie Consultant of Teamlead Service Engineers. Heb je een sterke IT/AI-kant? Dan is er alle ruimte om die in te zetten voor het verbeteren van onze interne processen. Bij ons bepaal jij mede de richting van je groei. Solliciteer direct! Ben je klaar voor een nieuwe uitdaging en zie jij jezelf als Service Engineer binnen ons team? Solliciteer dan direct en wie weet ben jij binnenkort onderdeel van het Whitevisionteam! Enthousiasme en de wil om jezelf te ontwikkelen vinden wij minstens zo belangrijk als je ervaring. (Bij indiensttreding vragen we om een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag.) Wanneer we positief zijn over je sollicitatie, starten we met een telefonisch kennismakingsgesprek. Vervolgens nodigen we je uit voor een eerste gesprek op locatie, gevolgd door een tweede gesprek als we beiden enthousiast zijn. Zo krijgen wij een volledig beeld van jou én jij ook van onze organisatie. Wil je eerst nog wat meer informatie over de functie of over Whitevision? Bel ons gerust via 076 560 7820. We vertellen je graag meer. (Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld.)
